payload.description: The PKCE challenge the Mac sent in the connect page's address (3.4): the unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the Mac's secret verifier. Asked when the user presses Connect.

reply.description: A one-time connect code bound to the challenge, good for one try within two minutes (3.4); or why there is none: signed-out, sync-off for an account whose Can sync is off or that is a guest, unavailable when the server cannot be reached.
